تستحيون (form X)
# تَسْتَحْيُونَ (tastaḥyūna) /tas.taħ.juː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# تُسْتَحْيَوْنَ (tustaḥyawna) /tus.taħ.jaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
